items.name: Ripplet
items.note: Bubble cheeks and ring markings connect the family.

items.name: Current Sail
items.note: The wave crest gives a distinct silhouette. Needs a less juvenile skull.

items.name: Estuary Mantle
items.note: Protective crescent collar, but the body remains close to the young form.

items.name: Ribbon Current
items.note: Long tail and swept cheeks; more elegant, less clearly crocodilian.

items.name: Current Sail · refined
items.note: Lower body and smaller eyes. Rear crest direction and markings still need reconciliation.

recommendation: Current Sail — refine the anatomy, preserve the wave.
reason: It changes the silhouette clearly while keeping Ripplet’s cheek and ring motifs. The first candidate still has juvenile eyes and proportions; the directional refinement explores a lower, longer crocodilian body.
